title: DojoLiq Mango Pineapple Passionfruit 10ml Nic Salt E-Liquid by Vaporesso
description: Vaporesso DojoLiq Mango Pineapple Passionfruit 10ml Nic Salt E-Liquid delivers a vibrant, layered, and deeply exotic tropical profile. Experience the dense, syrupy sweetness of ripe Mango and tangy Pineapple on the inhale, which is then seamlessly complemented by the sharp, slightly acidic bite of fresh Passionfruit on the exhale, for a complex yet superbly balanced and distinctively sunny finish. Formulated with a bespoke VG/PG ratio finely tuned specifically to this flavour, this premium nicotine salt e-liquid is crafted to provide precise clarity and a smooth, comfortable throat sensation. Available in 5mg,10mg and 20mg strengths, it ensures rapid nicotine satisfaction. This tailored blend performs reliably with Mouth-to-Lung (MTL) refillable pod kits and classic starter devices, ensuring sharp and accurate flavour transmission. Brought to you by the hardware specialists at Vaporesso, the DojoLiq collection captures the vibrant, authentic flavours of their popular Dojo series in a versatile 10ml format. Offering more than 30 expertly crafted options, this range provides a highly cost-effective and dependable option for every palate. Beyond the exotic fruit layers of Mango Pineapple Passionfruit, vapers can explore other compelling profiles such as the dark Black Cherry Raspberry or the elegant Apple Elderflower.
